title: John wants yield on his token

scenes.narration: John holds Apple from Oakmere. He would like it to earn something, or to borrow against it. He doesn't know where to start.
His token's page on RWA Sonar lists where this exact token is used in DeFi. Right now, three places.
On Lanternfish Lend, he can post it as collateral and borrow dollars. If Apple falls far enough, his tokens are sold to repay the loan. That is liquidation.
Saltmarsh Vaults runs a strategy with his tokens for a yield. Now the vault's own keys matter too. Here, one key can upgrade the vault program.
In a Brinepool pool, he pairs the token with dollars and earns trading fees. When the price moves, he gets back a different mix than he put in.
Each step adds a party he depends on, on top of Oakmere and its custodian. The site lists them in order.
See where your token is used, and what each use adds, at RWA Sonar dot com.
